sourceProjection.basis: Four top-down drawings on COAM Arquitectura 172 page 26 were re-cropped at equal x/y scale from the original page image. Plan IV retains the separately printed plan 11 inset above its main plan.

review: The original COAM PDF is retained with SHA-256 5e9142e7f86546004eb9346a64fa21cffa8dce56cbfc964063eb98a685549c64. The v2 derivative is an unwarped 4x render crop with blank clearance above every complete north wall. Numeric masks follow individual glyph bounds; scale bars and Roman sheet labels are outside the architectural crop or separately masked. Plan I's curved treads in area 5 are flat detail. The source section places plan 11 over area 7 at approximately the same upper elevation as area 12; because the publication prints 11 as a detached inset without horizontal registration, plan IV preserves its source-page separation and does not infer a horizontal offset.
limitations: 显示历史建筑的四层平面；后续扩建与当前通道变化未纳入。
上层的 11 号局部图独立显示，不表示它与主图的实际水平距离。
internalNotes: 模型仅含四张历史建筑平面，不把跨越多层的座位图堆叠成第五层，也不称作当前游览楼层。
图号 11 为原刊在 IV 主图上方单列的局部上层平面；剖面证明其位于左侧上层，但原刊未给出与 IV 主图的水平配准，因此按版面分离呈现。
印刷编号仅保留为语义标签；字形按像素边界移除，不以跨墙矩形删除。楼梯、座席与弧形踏步保持为平面细部。
